description: Record a paid or settled manual expense (or refund) on the tour budget. Requires Manage finance and tour-wide access.

amount.description: Amount (positive) as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

category.description: Expense category: airfare, lodging, ground_transport, meals, fuel, parking_tolls, production, supplies, fees, other, per_diem, crew_wages, commission, visa_immigration, insurance, equipment_rental, venue, marketing, merchandise, catering, communications, bank_fees.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code in capitals, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

fundingKind.description: Who paid: tour_cash, agency, crew_personal (someone to reimburse), noncash_settlement, or unknown.

incurredOn.description: Date the cost was incurred, YYYY-MM-DD.

merchant.description: Who was paid, e.g. the hotel or airline.

operationId.description: Optional. Leave empty for a new action. When a previous attempt of this exact call failed with an unknown outcome, pass the operationId that attempt reported so TourPro applies it at most once.

payerName.description: Name of the person who paid, if not tour cash.

paymentMethod.description: How it was paid, e.g. card, cash.

tourEventId.description: Optional event id (see list_events) the expense belongs to.

transactionType.description: expense (the default) for a cost, refund for money back on a cost.

name: create_tour_expense
title: Create tour expense
